title.narrative: Supporting Covid19 Preparedness and Response through Improved Access to WASH to the Vulnerable Population in Major Urban Centres of Mozambique

description.narrative: UN-Habitat will work with the central and local Government, Communities and National Associations of Municipalities to improve access to WASH and behaviour change solutions for COVID-19 response in vulnerable urban areas of Mozambique with focus on Metropolitan Area of Maputo, Beira Corridor including Tete and Pemba. The expected outcome is increased access to sustainable solutions that enable increased access to WASH, preventive measures and proven behaviour change techniques in urban areas, with a special focus on public spaces, markets and informal settlements for the COVID-19 pandemic preparedness and response in Urban Centers of Mozambique.

sector.narrative: Basic drinking water supply and basic sanitation
